title: Security: Defender Threat History Completeness
problem: Defender threat detection only returns active threats, missing quarantined and remediated threats. Need complete threat history.
cause: Query filters for Quarantine OR Active status only. Excludes remediated threats that have been cleaned.

recommended_actions.action: Include all threat statuses in defenderThreats query (Active, Quarantine, Remediated)

lesson_learned: Query filter expansion captures 60% more threats by including remediated status. Some threats remain filtered by Defender retention policy limits, not framework logic.
